title: Spectral Unforgetting: Post-Hoc Recovery of Damaged Capabilities Without Retraining
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for mitigating catastrophic forgetting in fine-tuned LLMs through spectral repair. While it evaluates its method using safety benchmarks like HarmBench and StrongREJECT to confirm that safety alignment is preserved, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning frameworks, or ethical systems.
